blocks.text: Sab se aam hayatiyati (biological) khatraat allergens, janwaron se insanon ko muntaqil hone wali mutaddi bimariyan, aur viral bimariyan hain (print ki Figure 16.3).

blocks.caption: Biological khatraat
rows: aise madde jo allergy ka radd-e-amal paida karein
janwaron se insanon ko muntaqil hone wali mutaddi bimariyan

blocks.prompt: Text 'janwaron se insanon ko muntaqil hone wali mutaddi bimariyan' ko laboratory ka khatra kyun ginta hai?
blocks.explanation: Laboratory mein sambhala jane wala hayatiyati material aur janwar aise infections rakh sakte hain jo logon ko lag jayein, is liye woh allergens aur viral bimariyon ke saath biological khatra hain.

items: Biological khatraat: allergens, janwaron se insanon ko mutaddi bimariyan, viral bimariyan.
